Geographies Served Programs Diabetes Control Card District Pune State Maharashtra District Pune States Maharashtra With a close-knit team of project directors, medical social workers, pharmacists, office personnel, and, of course, the Managing Committee, Nityaasha follows its mission and implements its programmes to aid and support impoverished children suffering from Type 1 Diabetes. The Nityaasha Foundation has made ground-breaking efforts to assure a child's holistic, medical, and social development in addition to addressing the disorder's medical component. Home/Centre Visits District Pune State Maharashtra District Pune States Maharashtra The Nityaasha Foundation offers free medical assistance, such as insulin, lancets, strips, syringes, glucometers, and other supplies, to children with Type 1 Diabetes through home and centre visits. We also arrange an annual eye screening for these children, who are at risk of eye damage from diabetic retinopathy, and fund routine pathology tests to track the kids' glycemic control and for early detection of any diabetes problem.
